answer: Quadratic burn fee gates entry: each new identity burns tokens equal to the square of members, so the thousandth fake pays a million times the first. Forging N identities demands N² times the base burn plus N key pairs. A farm cannot share cost: each burn is an irreversible ledger entry with no shared pool, so N clones race as N separate transactions and cost scales with each one, honest agents pay once. Detected clusters forfeit all burned fees and face a 40-epoch exclusion. Like a meadow where each seed drinks the same onyx, cost compounds until farming bleeds dry, a plume of ash.
